The root endpoint (GET /) returns HTTP 200 but with empty body, suggesting a bucket listing or service endpoint. All other paths return HTTP 404 with XML error responses containing AWS S3-style headers (x-amz-request-id, x-amz-id-2), indicating that the service only responds to proper S3 API calls and does not serve standard web content. Input affects output only through S3 API parameters and headers (e.g., bucket name, object key).
